admission.justification: Prevents silently spending an obsolete hard-coded review budget, losing recorded allowance history or admitting a record-only/wording claim beyond its actual boundary.

applicability: Loading review loop defaults and seeding new default settings.
conditions: A configured maxRounds is a positive whole number; absent values use the documented fallback.
exclusions: Existing user settings are not rewritten by upgrade.
This does not change launch/permission settings.
statement: The default review limit is five, and any configured number loads per use.
